dji - air 3s drone fly more combo with r.name: DJI - Air 3S Drone Fly More Combo with RC-N3 Remote Controller
dji - air 3s drone fly more combo with r.description: With the DJI Air 3S Drone Fly More Combo, featuring the RC-N3 Remote Controller, elevate your travel photography to new heights. This dual-camera drone is engineered for capturing breathtaking imagery, integrating cutting-edge technology to ensure every aerial moment is maximized. The DJI Air 3S is equipped with a 1-inch CMOS primary camera and a 70mm medium tele camera, both offering up to 14 stops of dynamic range. This allows you to capture stunning landscapes, portraits, and more with exceptional detail and clarity.The primary camera boasts a 50MP sensor with a 24mm lens, perfect for wide-angle shots that capture expansive vistas with enhanced clarity. Meanwhile, the medium tele camera, with its 48MP 1/1.3-inch CMOS sensor and 70mm lens, excels in portrait and vehicle photography, offering a cinematic look with its compressed depth of field. Both cameras support the innovative Free panorama feature, enabling seamless panoramic shots by stitching multiple images together.The DJI Air 3S is designed for versatility and creativity, supporting features like 4K/60fps HDR and 4K/120fps video recording, along with a 10-bit D-Log M color mode for vibrant, true-to-life colors. The drone's advanced video encoding compression algorithm reduces file sizes by over 30% without sacrificing image quality, making it a practical choice for creators on the go.Safety and ease of use are paramount with the DJI Air 3S. It features an omnidirectional vision sensing system, including forward-facing LiDAR and downward infrared time-of-flight sensors, ensuring safe navigation even in low-light conditions. The next-gen Smart RTH (Return to Home) function memorizes flight paths for safe returns, even without GPS signals, making it ideal for urban environments.The DJI Air 3S also includes ActiveTrack 360 Degree, which keeps your subject in focus and optimally framed, automatically adjusting the flight path for the best shots. With up to 45 minutes of flight time and DJI's O4 FHD video transmission technology, you can enjoy smooth, vivid live feeds over distances of up to 20 kilometers.This Fly More Combo comes with the DJI RC-N3 remote controller, an ND filter set, two additional batteries, a battery charging hub, and a shoulder bag, providing everything you need for extended shooting sessions. The intelligent flight battery offers up to 45 minutes of flight time, while the ND filter set (ND8/32/128) allows for lower shutter speeds, ensuring smoother footage.Experience the DJI Air 3S Drone Fly More Combo and unlock the full potential of your aerial photography with its unmatched imaging capabilities and comprehensive safety features.
